g.text: Existing QNT: schedules and permit lifetime
Existing Lean: data and mapping algebra
Worker independence needs a complete frozen root view and park/reload protocol
Unique object authority alone does not prove frame coordinates or structural link completion
Participant withdrawal cannot discard private or descendant work
Final callbacks and resources can outlive execution admission
Frame consumers share a Scheme-owned semantic source
Native results qualify only the actual generated/header/object closure
